name: @aethelred/wallet-swap-solver
description: Concrete intent-router Solver for SwapIntent — translates an intent into a sequence of on-chain txs against a pluggable SwapVenue (Uniswap v3, CoW batch, 1inch, or any DEX adapter). Third production-shape solver after transfer-solver + x402-solver, completing the ≤/===/≥ commitment matrix across all three intent kinds.
